[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/cli_response_files.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Explicit Linux file provider borrowing one stable directory descriptor for all relative includes. It checks regular-file metadata and actual EOF, admits finite native-call credits with a close reserve and retires each acquired descriptor once even on close error. The public smoke and a direct 39-case provider oracle group execute on Linux x86_64, with admission, fixed-base lookup, byte/call caps and native failure/cleanup checks. The separate 31-case ownership group has 29 reached source OOMs and two baselines; counts overlap and are not two Rust-libtest passes. Source byte grants can be reduced by expansion source/work budgets. Ordinary lookup is not containment, and call limits do not bound filesystem wall time.
